name: Lucile Filarete
original_name: ルシル フィアレーテ
source:
"What? Um... Hmm... I dunno..."

What more to life is there than solitude?

A half-elf NPC that is demure and pensive, if not frail. Generally, Elves are regarded for their wisdom, but this seems not to be the case with Lucile. She is often caught day-dreaming or muttering by [url=/c84006]Shiina's[/url] party, adding to her mysterious nature.

[From [url=https://ideafintl.com/death-request/chara/]Idea Factory[/url]]

[spoiler]Her real name is Svetlana Amou (スヴェトラーナ・天羽).[/spoiler]
